summary: A magistrates’ strike was announced for September, but no observed execution, public gathering, or participation evidence was found in the captured searches. Keep pending evidence; do not code announced dates as event dates.

Prior judicial strikes occurred earlier in 2025, but the available search results do not establish continuity or separate onsets for the planned September action. The September notice may be a continuation or a new wave; unresolved.

Searches were in Portuguese, French, English and Kriol. Kriol search results returned mainly Portuguese. Coverage remained Bissau/national-source centered; no separate Mandinka, Fula, Balanta or region-specific island archive review.

The October 3 ANG item concerns an October strike and is not evidence of September execution. Further post-announcement follow-up for the magistrates’ planned September strike was not located; no new body was opened.

Provisional country code 404; official baseline pending. Actual retrieval date is 2026-10-11, after the fixed 2025-10-07 cutoff; later search results from 2026 and unrelated Guinea/Portugal were excluded.
